_comment: Reviewed data: for each gMSA and dMSA, the principals allowed to retrieve its managed password (PrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword, which sets msDS-GroupMSAMembership), as distinguished names. Change it in a reviewed pull request; the run records this file's SHA-256. A gMSA's entry is exactly one domain local security group of the hosts that run it, DL-gMSA-<app>-Hosts, never a computer account (WD-160; Learn recommends a security group of the hosts). A dMSA's entry is the hosts it learned during its migration (Learn), so the group rule doesn't apply to it. 'requests' names, for each account whose retrievers this file changes, the SailPoint request (requestId) and ServiceNow change (changeRecord) that approved the change; the plan blocks a retriever change without both.
